jobs.title: Management Consulting Director, Technology
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

RSM is seeking a growth-oriented Management Consulting Director to join our Technology Performance practice. This leader will play a critical role in driving the continued growth of the practice by expanding strategic client relationships, developing new market opportunities, and leading complex technology transformation engagements.

This Director will combine strong business development capabilities with deep expertise in Technology Strategy, ERP Strategy, IT Architecture, and complex transformation program leadership. The role requires a leader who can originate opportunities, shape solutions, build trusted executive relationships, oversee complex engagements, and develop high-performing consulting teams.

The ideal candidate is a proven consulting leader who can connect business strategy with technology, helping organizations make critical technology investment decisions, modernize their enterprise environments, and successfully execute large-scale transformation initiatives. This individual will also help shape the continued evolution of the Technology Performance practice by developing talent, strengthening capabilities, and bringing differentiated solutions to market.

Responsibilities

Practice Growth & Market Leadership

Drive growth of the Technology Performance practice through business development, account expansion, relationship building, and new client acquisition.
Build and manage a strong pipeline of technology consulting and transformation opportunities.
Develop trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, COOs, and other business and technology leaders.
Lead strategic pursuits from opportunity identification and solution development through proposal creation, executive presentations, and contract award.
Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships by connecting business priorities with RSM’s broader technology and consulting capabilities.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies around key Technology Performance offerings and emerging client needs.
Contribute to the practice’s market presence through thought leadership, industry events, executive presentations, and development of differentiated offerings.

Client & Engagement Leadership

Serve as a senior trusted advisor to executives navigating complex technology strategies, investments, and transformation programs.
Lead engagements spanning Technology Strategy, ERP Strategy and Selection, IT Architecture, enterprise application modernization, digital transformation, and technology operating model design.
Advise clients on aligning technology investments and roadmaps with business strategy, growth objectives, operational needs, and financial priorities.
Lead and oversee complex, multi-workstream transformation programs involving business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and third-party partners.
Lead executive workshops, technology assessments, and strategy sessions and translate findings into actionable transformation roadmaps.
Provide executive oversight across engagements, ensuring high-quality delivery, strong client relationships, financial performance, appropriate risk management, and successful business outcomes.
Support clients through significant business and technology events, including enterprise modernization, organizational growth, transactions, integrations, carve-outs, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

Technology Transformation Leadership

Serve as a subject matter expert in technology strategy and transformation, bringing a strong point of view on how organizations can use technology to enable business growth and improve performance.
Lead technology strategy and roadmap development, including assessment of current-state capabilities, identification of gaps, investment prioritization, and future-state planning.
Advise clients on ERP strategy, modernization, selection, implementation planning, and optimization, including the broader business and operating model implications of ERP transformation.
Assess existing IT and enterprise architecture and develop future-state architectures that support scalability, integration, modernization, and business objectives.
Provide leadership across complex technology environments involving ERP, cloud, data and analytics, AI, automation, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and integration architecture.
Bring structure, governance, and executive leadership to large and complex transformation programs, including program strategy, executive governance, vendor coordination, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment.
Evaluate technology environments and recommend practical, business-focused solutions that balance modernization goals, investment requirements, organizational readiness, and risk.
Stay current on emerging technologies, market trends, ERP platforms, AI capabilities, and evolving technology operating models and translate those developments into practical client solutions and new market opportunities.

People & Practice Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop consulting professionals across multiple levels, creating a culture of high performance, accountability, collaboration, and continuous development.
Build scalable consulting capabilities by developing talent, methodologies, intellectual capital, and repeatable solutions.
Coach and develop team members while identifying and preparing future leaders within the practice.
Collaborate with practice leadership on recruiting, workforce planning, capability development, and strategic investments needed to support continued growth.
Foster collaboration across RSM service lines and capabilities to deliver integrated solutions and create broader client relationships.
Help establish and maintain standards for engagement quality, client service, delivery excellence, and team performance.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree.
12+ years of management consulting, technology consulting, or technology transformation experience, including progressively increasing leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience selling, shaping, and delivering complex technology consulting engagements.
Proven track record of business development, account growth, executive relationship management, and consulting sales.
Deep experience in one or more core areas including Technology Strategy, ERP Strategy, IT Architecture, or large-scale technology transformation.
Experience leading complex, multi-workstream programs involving business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership.
Strong understanding of enterprise technology environments, including ERP platforms, enterprise applications, cloud, data and analytics, integration, AI, and automation.
Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy and operational requirements into technology roadmaps, architectures, and investment priorities.
Strong project and program management capabilities, with experience leading complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders, workstreams, technologies, and vendors.
Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary consulting teams.
Strong executive presence with the ability to advise and influence C-suite and senior business and technology leaders.
Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, risk, and client expectations.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and business needs, up to 50% (Canada and US)

Preferred

Experience advising clients within Private Equity, Real Estate, Construction, Consumer Products/CPG, or other complex business environments.
Experience supporting technology strategy and transformation across the Private Equity transaction lifecycle, including technology due diligence, post-close planning, integrations, carve-outs, and portfolio company transformation.
Experience working with construction, real estate, or capital-intensive organizations with complex technology, ERP, project management, or operational environments.
Experience leading ERP modernization, enterprise application transformation, or ERP strategy and selection initiatives.
Experience developing enterprise, solution, or technology architecture strategies within complex IT environments.
Experience overseeing major transformation programs involving multiple workstreams, vendors, platforms, and executive stakeholders.
Experience developing go-to-market strategies, building consulting offerings, and helping scale a technology consulting practice.
Relevant advanced degree or professional certifications in areas such as enterprise architecture, ERP, cloud, program management, or technology transformation.

jobs.title: Director Strategy and Delivery Real World Late Phase
jobs.description:
Description

Director Strategy and Delivery Real World Late Phase

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Summary

The Director, Strategy & Delivery, Real World Late Phase (RWLP), independently leads customer engagements from pre-award strategy through study delivery. The role combines ownership of study strategy, proposal development and bid defenses with operational and financial oversight of assigned studies, programs and portfolios. The Director partners with Business Development and Medical Strategy to secure new business, support account growth and ensure that proposal commitments translate into achievable delivery plans.

The Director develops practical delivery solutions for non-interventional and interventional late-phase research, including prospective and retrospective observational studies, registries, postmarketing safety and effectiveness studies, pragmatic studies and long-term follow-up. Working with Business Development, Medical, Epidemiology, Biostatistics and other functional leaders, the Director translates evidence needs into feasible study plans, budgets and delivery commitments. The role is accountable for customer satisfaction, study and portfolio performance, and the development of assigned teams.

Strategy and customer engagement

Lead strategy for assigned RWLP opportunities, aligning customer evidence needs with study design, data availability, country requirements, operational feasibility and budget.
Lead proposal development and writing and bid defense preparation, including delivery models, country and site strategy, staffing, assumptions, timelines, budgets and risk mitigation. Coach team members to present their expertise and proposed solutions clearly.
Partner with Business Development and account leaders to develop customer relationships, identify follow-on opportunities and demonstrate RWLP capabilities through credible delivery commitments.
Ensure an effective transition from proposal to delivery, with clear ownership of commitments, assumptions, scope, resources and customer expectations.

RWLP study design and delivery

Apply working knowledge of interventional and non-interventional study designs, including cohort, case-control and cross-sectional studies; prospective and retrospective registries; chart reviews; pragmatic trials; postmarketing studies; and extension or long-term follow-up programs.
Partner with Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Medical to assess whether proposed populations, endpoints, follow-up schedules and data sources can answer the study objectives. Translate scientific recommendations into operational plans without substituting for specialist scientific accountability.
Assess delivery options using primary data collection, secondary data sources or a combination of both, including electronic health records, claims and existing registries. Identify data access, completeness, linkage, consent and site-workflow requirements with the relevant specialists.
Oversee feasibility, country and site selection, startup, recruitment, retention, monitoring, data collection and closeout. Adapt delivery to routine care and site capabilities while meeting protocol and applicable quality requirements.
Ensure monitoring and oversight are proportionate to study design, data risks and applicable requirements. Coordinate safety reporting, vendor oversight and event adjudication where required by the protocol.
Oversee assigned studies and portfolios against scope, timeline, quality and financial commitments. Review performance trends, resolve escalations and lead recovery plans with clear owners and deadlines.

Operational leadership and people management

Lead portfolio reviews and governance discussions; identify recurring delivery issues, capacity constraints and opportunities to improve execution across studies.
Partner with functional and resource leaders to forecast demand, allocate staff and balance workload, skills, continuity and cost across the assigned portfolio.
Provide line management for designated employees where assigned, including recruitment, onboarding, objective setting, coaching, performance reviews, development planning and succession planning.
Assess employee readiness for assigned responsibilities, identify training needs and oversee project handovers and role transitions. Address performance concerns with HR and the appropriate functional leaders.
Develop project leaders and cross-functional teams, clarify accountability and promote consistent delivery practices. Maintain defined decision rights with the ODL and functional leadership under the approved operating model.

Financial performance, quality and compliance

Own financial oversight for assigned studies and programs, including budget review, forecasting, resource utilization, profitability, scope management and timely change orders. Resolve variances with project teams and Finance.
Apply Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and applicable local requirements according to study classification and activities. Work with Regulatory and Quality to confirm the appropriate framework.
Ensure compliance with company procedures, contractual commitments and applicable customer requirements. Coordinate ethics review, informed consent or approved waivers, privacy and data governance requirements with the responsible functions.
Maintain oversight of quality risks, deviations and corrective and preventive actions; support audit and inspection readiness and timely resolution of findings.
Use delivery metrics, customer feedback and lessons learned to improve RWLP processes, proposal assumptions, budget models and execution.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing, public health, epidemiology or a related discipline, or equivalent education and related experience. An advanced relevant degree is preferred.
Extensive relevant research experience within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or comparable research organization, including demonstrated leadership of RWLP programs. Direct experience delivering both non-interventional and interventional late-phase studies is required.
Demonstrated understanding of observational and interventional study designs, routine-care research, primary and secondary data collection, and their operational implications.
Working knowledge of GPP, GCP and applicable global and local requirements for late-phase and non-interventional research, with the ability to apply the appropriate framework with specialist support.
Proven experience leading proposals, bid defenses and senior customer discussions, and translating evidence objectives into feasible, appropriately costed delivery plans.
Demonstrated portfolio or multi-study oversight, operational problem-solving, financial forecasting, resource planning and scope management.
Experience developing staff and leading cross-functional teams. Direct people-management experience is required where the role includes line-management accountability.
Ability to work effectively with Medical, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Regulatory, Safety, Data Management and technology partners; sufficient therapeutic-area knowledge to lead credible customer discussions and identify when specialist input is needed.
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and decision-making skills; ability to manage competing priorities and resolve issues with senior stakeholders.
Proficiency in core business and project-management tools; fluency in English; willingness to travel approximately 25%, consistent with business needs.

Critical Skills

RWLP strategy and delivery; study-design literacy; customer engagement; bid defense leadership; portfolio oversight; people development; resource planning; financial management; risk-based quality oversight; cross-functional decision-making.

US Experience Requirements

At least eight years of relevant research experience, including at least seven years managing studies, with demonstrated experience leading RWLP programs across interventional and non-interventional research.

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

US Physical Requirements and Work Environment

Physical Requirements: Position requires: ability to occasionally move about inside the office to access filing cabinets, office equipment, etc. and to move between office locations; ability to maintain a stationary position for prolonged periods of time; ability to occasionally manipulate (e.g., lift, carry, move) office items and packages of light to medium weights of 10-35 pounds; ability to constantly operate a computer and other office productivity equipment (e.g., scanner, phone, printer, copier); ability to perceive and assess written materials for prolonged periods of time; and ability to frequently communicate with colleagues on the phone, by email, and in-person. Work Environment: This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. The noise level in the work environment is low.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Job Summary

Global Wealth & Asset Management (GWAM) is a key growth segment for Manulife. We operate three different channels (Retail, Retirement and Institutional) and are a major player in North America, Asia and Europe.

Our Retirement & Wealth business serves over 6M customers worldwide, is a key contributor to GWAM earnings and is well positioned in all of our key markets.

Reporting to the Head of GWAM Strategy & Transformation, the AVP, Retirement & Wealth Strategy is a key member of the finance & strategy team and an important catalyst and contributor to the overall strategy, growth, and transformation of our global franchise. The role is trusted advisor to the entire Retirement & Wealth Leadership Team, providing key insights and information to drive the development and execution of our strategy.

Responsibilities

Analyze key business priorities and bring insights to generate executive action that creates value for Retirement & Wealth
Build & maintain the strategy for these channels and engage the global and regional Leadership Teams in strategy development discussions
Translate strategy into actionable priorities, working with regional Leadership Teams to drive execution and accountability.
Establish and drive cross-functional collaboration and engagement across these teams, focusing on execution and business readiness in support of the global Retirement & Wealth strategy
Partner with the Portfolio Governance & Oversight team to ensure the project book aligns with the agreed upon strategic roadmap
Work closely with Finance partners to monitor progress on strategy execution and delivery, identifying areas of intervention and required pivots where needed
Manage strategy professionals to drive the Retirement & Wealth strategy & transformation
Align with competitive and market intel to ensure the strategic goals are both aspirational and achievable
Lead the development of communications to the Board of Directors, Executive Leadership Team, Transformation Delivery Team and other senior audiences
Generate appropriate communications material for various external audiences like analyst meetings/calls, rating agency presentations, and external conferences
Assist in the development of internal Retirement & Wealth communications plan to effectively communicate progress against strategic priorities

Key Attributes And Behaviors

Minimum of 12 years of relevant, progressively senior experience, in Strategy, Transformation, or Consulting – with strong experience in the wealth and asset management industry
Ability to work independently, get to the relevant information and pierce through siloes
Ability to handle difficult situations, deal efficiently with escalation
Strong business acumen and comprehensive knowledge of the Retirement & Wealth operating model in North America
Ability to connect the dots and rapidly identify and surface the relevant patterns and issues
Politically astute, with strong situational sensitivity and ability to influence
Exceptional organization and project management skills
Emotional intelligence, with ability to demonstrate judgment, discretion and diplomacy
Ability to see pressures the leadership team faces in pushing the organization to change and find ways to lessen them
Result-oriented with an ability to multi-task, prioritize across multiple initiatives, drive accountability, and develop creative solutions where blueprints may not exist
Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to articulate complex business problems in simple and impactful words
Ability to develop a clear position / point of view on key questions and issues impacting the business
Experience managing teams, both directly, and indirectly through influence

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Lead from the Front: Roll up your sleeves to actively coach your team through participating in calls, reviewing deal strategy, and providing actionable feedback using tools like Gong and Lattice.

Forecasting & Reporting
Forecast with Precision: Work with the Senior Leadership Team to set ambitious targets, develop accurate sales forecasts, and report on progress to the company and the Board of Directors.
Embrace Data: Make data-driven decisions the standard across the sales organization, using analytics to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.

Culture
Foster and scale a culture of discipline, continuous learning, competitiveness, collaboration, and celebrating success — what’s missing?
Champion Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster a strong, collaborative relationship with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our GTM strategy is cohesive and our sales team is set up for success.
Actively work to keep a pulse on the engagement, challenges, and well-being of your team

Research & Awareness
Work with other Loopio leaders to monitor trends in customers, market, and competitive landscape
Ensure strong alignment between Product Management and Sales to set your team up for success
Keep a pulse on trends, new tools, and best practices in SaaS software sales

AI & Automation: Drive the adoption of AI tools and automated workflows across the team to accelerate pipeline generation, enhance account intelligence, and optimize deal execution and coaching.

✨ What You’ll Bring To The Team

10+ years in B2B software sales, with a focus in new business acquisition
3+ years in B2B Enterprise SaaS software leadership (Director level and above)
Experience leading a team of Enterprise Account Executives
Track record of setting and exceeding targets
Deep analytical abilities and metrics-driven approach

Strong understanding of the RFP response process and the challenges that companies face
Well-defined leadership style that can be articulated clearly
Experience with MEDDPICC and Command of the Message would be ideal
Relevant Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or business function
Strong assets:
Experience selling to Sales and Marketing organizations
History of published thought leadership
Experience in scaling a sales team and contributing to organizational growth from $50M to $100M ARR.

Where You’ll Work 📍

We are currently only looking for candidates who reside in the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding areas and can access our co-working space in Downtown Toronto for the occasional Team get-together.
Loopio is a remote-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from.
Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇺🇲 US, 🇮🇳 India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and 🇬🇧 London.
The majority of our team is based in ON and BC, which means these employees live and work remotely within a 300km radius of Toronto (within Ontario) and Vancouver (Within BC).
We offer flexible co-working locations available to Loopers in ON and BC. Those based in ON have the option of working out of our convenient co-working space located in the heart of Downtown Toronto and a 12-minute walk from Union Station. BC Loopers have the option to work centrally in Vancouver. It is whatever works best for you!
You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work 🙇🏾 during the workday
We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!

Why You’ll ♥️ Working at Loopio

Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice for our 1:1s and performance conversations
You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.
We offer a wide range of health and wellness benefits to support your physical and mental well-being, starting day 1️⃣ with Loopio.
We’ll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up.
We’ll give you a Claude account to experiment with, automate your routine tasks, and build tools so you can work smarter every day.
You’ll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment.
Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and company celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!
Our four Employee Resource Groups offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round.
You’ll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business.

Questioning your qualifications? Read this
‼️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don’t apply for a position simply because they don’t hit every single criteria included in the job description—particularly members of underrepresented groups.

Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you’re self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you’d like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table.

AI in Recruitment 👩🏻‍💻
At Loopio, we leverage artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines

AI Usage in Interviews
🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process.

For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making.

Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from all
backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team ( work@loopio.com ) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Global Wealth & Asset Management (GWAM) is a key growth segment for Manulife. We operate three different channels (Retail, Retirement and Institutional) and are a major player in North America, Asia and Europe.

Our Retirement & Wealth business serves over 6M customers worldwide, is a key contributor to GWAM earnings and is well positioned in all of our key markets.

Reporting to the Head of GWAM Strategy & Transformation, the AVP, Retirement & Wealth Strategy is a key member of the finance & strategy team and an important catalyst and contributor to the overall strategy, growth, and transformation of our global franchise. The role is trusted advisor to the entire Retirement & Wealth Leadership Team, providing key insights and information to drive the development and execution of our strategy.

Responsibilities

Analyze key business priorities and bring insights to generate executive action that creates value for Retirement & Wealth
Build & maintain the strategy for these channels and engage the global and regional Leadership Teams in strategy development discussions
Translate strategy into actionable priorities, working with regional Leadership Teams to drive execution and accountability.
Establish and drive cross-functional collaboration and engagement across these teams, focusing on execution and business readiness in support of the global Retirement & Wealth strategy
Partner with the Portfolio Governance & Oversight team to ensure the project book aligns with the agreed upon strategic roadmap
Work closely with Finance partners to monitor progress on strategy execution and delivery, identifying areas of intervention and required pivots where needed
Manage strategy professionals to drive the Retirement & Wealth strategy & transformation
Align with competitive and market intel to ensure the strategic goals are both aspirational and achievable
Lead the development of communications to the Board of Directors, Executive Leadership Team, Transformation Delivery Team and other senior audiences
Generate appropriate communications material for various external audiences like analyst meetings/calls, rating agency presentations, and external conferences
Assist in the development of internal Retirement & Wealth communications plan to effectively communicate progress against strategic priorities

Key Attributes And Behaviors

Minimum of 12 years of relevant, progressively senior experience, in Strategy, Transformation, or Consulting – with strong experience in the wealth and asset management industry
Ability to work independently, get to the relevant information and pierce through siloes
Ability to handle difficult situations, deal efficiently with escalation
Strong business acumen and comprehensive knowledge of the Retirement & Wealth operating model in North America
Ability to connect the dots and rapidly identify and surface the relevant patterns and issues
Politically astute, with strong situational sensitivity and ability to influence
Exceptional organization and project management skills
Emotional intelligence, with ability to demonstrate judgment, discretion and diplomacy
Ability to see pressures the leadership team faces in pushing the organization to change and find ways to lessen them
Result-oriented with an ability to multi-task, prioritize across multiple initiatives, drive accountability, and develop creative solutions where blueprints may not exist
Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to articulate complex business problems in simple and impactful words
Ability to develop a clear position / point of view on key questions and issues impacting the business
Experience managing teams, both directly, and indirectly through influence

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
